annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2020/49 of 21 January 2020 correcting the German language version of Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 supplementing Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6)
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2020/49 of 21 January 2020 correcting the German language version of Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions (Euro 5 and Euro 6)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 17/1
annotation.summary_en: This is a European Commission regulation that corrects the German-language version of Regulation (EU) 2017/1151, the Euro 5/6 rules on vehicle emissions type-approval. It fixes provisions where the German text had reversed the meaning: additional wheels and tyres are not to be treated as optional equipment. It does not deal with AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects the German version of points in Sub-Annexes 4 and 7 to Annex XXI of Regulation (EU) 2017/1151
Clarifies that additional wheels and tyres are not to be considered optional equipment
Other language versions are not affected
Enters into force on the third day after publication in the Official Journal
